author: Cleo Abram
description:
Nearly 3500 meters under the sea off the coast of Sicily sits 51 strings holding 18 spheres each. They sway in the pitch black water and wait for signals from the universe. 

Scientists have been building this mysterious observatory since 2015, and in February of 2023 they finally saw something. 

Subscribe for more!

#science #neutrinos #observatory
title: There's a Telescope at the Bottom of the Ocean
